title: The golden 'Ex 1 - LBO' sheet holds stale cached values from a data-table substitution pass, so its cells contradict their own formulas and cannot be reproduced by a correct recalculated output.
confirmation: Golden 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11=18.2034 while its source C20=14.2034, and C32=109.52 vs 81.73*1.24=101.35. Running the golden itself through the production recalc (data tables frozen) gives C11=14.20, C32=101.35, F21=8101.8, so the golden fails its own check (mod 0.744).

title: Golden forecast cells for 2030 use driver values that differ from the referenced cells, so a recalculated output will diverge by more than the 1% tolerance.
confirmation: Golden U41=0.137 and U43=0.264 while M17/M27 give 0.092/0.2215. The production-recalculated golden yields U41=0.092, U17=6211.8 and U23=1375.96, which miss the golden values by far more than 1%.

title: Golden returns-analysis equity contributions are inconsistent: X24 and Y24:AC24 use the same formula but hold different values.
evidence: Golden X24=8987.82 (=$F$21) but Y24:AC24=8101.82 (=$F$21). Cascading values X23:AC26=8987.82 also fall inside the compared range B1:AK95.
confirmation: Golden X23:AC26 hold 8987.82 while the same =$F$21 formula recalculates to 8101.82. The recalculated golden fails on X23, X24, X26 and Y23:AC26.
